note: Packages whose generated headers are allowed to fail the compile gate without failing the build, so a broken package nothing needs cannot hold the SDK hostage. A deferral is a declaration, never a silent skip: every gate that honors this file reports what it deferred, and a deferral is REFUSED when a non-deferred header includes the deferred package, because deferring a package something still includes hides a real break instead of parking an irrelevant one. Deferral changes no generated output -- headers are still emitted and still compiled, so progress stays visible and un-deferring is a one-line change.
